title: Superhuman button
description: A flat 8px-radius button with a semi-bold label. Filled purple (primary), filled lilac (secondary, for deep fields) or a thin outline. The fill deepens on hover over 0.2s.
notes: variant secondary and outline are made for deep surfaces; primary for the light page
sizes: md (52px) in section headings, sm (36px) in the hero
name: superhuman-button

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: purple fill · secondary: lilac fill with dark text · outline: thin white ring for deep fields

props.name: size
props.description: md is the section-heading button, sm sits in the hero
